description: Exploit. On the E007 recipe (Muon + Lookahead/EMA + progressive resizing 24→28→32 px, 9 epochs), change only the epoch count from 9 to 8.5. Keep the resolution split as fractions of total steps (about 40/30/30%) and stretch the LR and EMA schedules to the new step count. Warm up every resolution in build with channels_last tensors from the training code path. Set torch._dynamo.config.error_on_recompile=True after build so a leak fails loudly. This spends part of E007's 0.60 pp margin and measures the slope with EMA and Muon on.
